title: Aureline M5 scaffold-preflight-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the scaffold-preflight-card family binds inside the frozen M5 scaffold-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-scaffold-component-matrix.schema.json). A scaffold preflight card names what is checked before a starter writes files and each check's outcome so a generic Create never hides a network, dependency-install, remote-provisioning, trust, or managed-workspace side effect. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-templates is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
